name: Physics — Measurement & Units
tagline: The SI spine: quantities, units, constants, and how we know we measured right.
domain_framing: This lab studies physics through measurement: SI quantities and units, the defining and CODATA constants, uncertainty, traceability, and calibration. Hypotheses concern values, units, dimensional consistency, and metrological practice. Cite BIPM, CODATA, or NIST for every factual claim.
vocabulary_register: Precise SI usage: unit symbols upright (kg, J·s), 'uncertainty' not 'error', state exactness ('exact, by definition of the SI') where it applies.
